description: Complete visual redesign to illustrated Seoul map style with landmarks, mountains, rivers, bridges, and rich animations

context.existing_stack: React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite + PixiJS 8 + Tailwind CSS
context.design_reference: Illustrated Seoul tourism map style: warm pink/beige district fills, white thick border lines between districts, layered green mountains around edges, landmark buildings as simple SVG illustrations, Han River with bridges, scattered trees/parks, tiny cute walking people

color_palette.buildings: cream/beige simple rectangles with colored roofs
color_palette.sky: not rendered as background - use cream/sage for surrounding area

mountains.북한산 (Bukhansan): North edge - large layered mountain range

sub_tasks.title: Complete SeoulMap SVG redesign - district shapes and color palette
sub_tasks.description: Completely rewrite the SeoulSVG component in SeoulMap.tsx. Change the visual style to match illustrated tourism map references. Changes: (1) District fill color from greens to warm pink/beige tones (#f2d5d0, #f0ccc6, #f5ddd8 etc with subtle variation per district). (2) District borders from thin green strokes to thick WHITE strokes (strokeWidth 3-4, stroke white). (3) Background/Gyeonggi area uses muted sage cream (#e8e6df). (4) Remove the current greenish linearGradient background. (5) Keep the existing district paths but adjust colors. (6) Extend SVG viewBox slightly if needed for mountains at edges. The overall look should shift from 'green terrain map' to 'warm illustrated tourism map'.
sub_tasks.acceptance: Districts show warm pink/beige fills with thick white borders. Background is muted sage. Overall color palette matches illustrated Seoul map style.

sub_tasks.title: Add mountains around Seoul edges
sub_tasks.description: Add mountain SVG illustrations around the edges of Seoul. Draw mountains as layered curved shapes using 2-3 shades of green (#5a8c5a darker back, #7aaa6a mid, #9ac88a lighter front). Mountains to add: (1) 북한산 (Bukhansan) - large mountain range along the entire NORTH edge, extending above the Seoul boundary. Multiple peaks, largest mountain feature. (2) 인왕산 (Inwangsan) - northwest, smaller range near Jongno/Seodaemun. (3) 남산 (Namsan) - small hill in center-south (Yongsan area), this is where N Tower sits. (4) 관악산 (Gwanaksan) - south edge, moderate size. (5) 아차산 (Achasan) - east edge near Gangdong. (6) 수락산/도봉산 - northeast. Add small triangular tree shapes (dark green) on the mountains using simple SVG polygons or paths. Mountains should overlap district edges slightly, rendered BEHIND districts but extending beyond the Seoul boundary into Gyeonggi area. They should look like layered green hills with depth.
sub_tasks.acceptance: Mountains visible around Seoul's north, south, east edges. Bukhansan is prominently large in the north. Each mountain has 2-3 layered green shades with tree silhouettes. Mountains create a natural border around the city.

sub_tasks.title: Redesign Han River with bridges and streams
sub_tasks.description: Redesign the Han River to be wider, more prominent, and include bridges. Changes: (1) Make the river 2x wider than current (about 30-35px SVG width instead of current ~20px). Use a solid sky blue (#8ec5e8) fill. (2) Add subtle wave pattern using a SVG path with slight undulations along the river edges. (3) Add 8-10 bridge crossings as small gray rectangles perpendicular to the river flow at realistic positions (Banpo, Hannam, Dongjak, Mapo, Yeongdong, Jamsil, Seongsu, Yangwha bridges etc). Bridges should be thin gray lines (#c0c0c0) with slightly wider ends. (4) Add 청계천 (Cheonggyecheon) as a thin light blue stream flowing east through Jung-gu/Jongno area. (5) Add 중랑천 as thin stream in Jungnang-gu area flowing into Han River. River should feel like a major geographic feature dividing the city.
sub_tasks.acceptance: Han River is wide and prominent sky blue. 8+ bridges cross the river. Cheonggyecheon stream visible as thin blue line in central Seoul. River is a dominant visual feature of the map.

sub_tasks.title: Add landmark illustrations as SVG
sub_tasks.description: Add simplified but recognizable landmark SVG illustrations at their correct positions on the map. Each landmark should be 30-60px in size, drawn with simple SVG shapes (rects, paths, circles). Landmarks to add: (1) 경복궁 - traditional Korean palace: red/brown roof (curved trapezoid) on beige base, at Jongno ~(320, 160). (2) 남산타워 - tower on green hill: thin tall gray tower with observation deck bulge, at ~(340, 250). (3) 롯데월드타워 - very tall thin modern skyscraper, slight taper, at Songpa ~(530, 370). (4) 63빌딩 - golden rectangular tall building near Yeouido ~(225, 310). (5) DDP - curved silver/gray organic shape at Dongdaemun ~(420, 190). (6) 국회의사당 - building with green dome at Yeouido ~(210, 330). (7) 코엑스 - large gray rectangle building at Gangnam ~(460, 400). (8) 김포공항 - small airplane icon with runway at Gangseo ~(120, 270). (9) 월드컵경기장 - oval stadium shape at Mapo ~(205, 195). (10) 올림픽공원 - park gate icon at Songpa ~(545, 410). Each landmark gets a small Korean label underneath in 7-8px font. Landmarks are rendered ABOVE districts but BELOW hotspot markers.
sub_tasks.acceptance: 10 recognizable landmark illustrations visible on the map at correct positions. Each has a Korean label. Landmarks are the right size - noticeable but not overwhelming.

sub_tasks.title: Add trees, parks, and environmental details
sub_tasks.description: Scatter environmental SVG elements across the map for visual richness: (1) Trees: 60-80 small tree icons scattered across the map, concentrated in park areas and along rivers. Each tree is a simple green circle (3-5px radius) on a thin brown stem (1px line). Use 2-3 shades of green for variety. (2) Park areas: Fill known park regions with slightly darker green (#b5d89a) patches: 올림픽공원 area, 서울숲 (near Seongdong), 여의도공원, 월드컵공원, 보라매공원. (3) Seoul Forest (서울숲): Dense cluster of 15-20 trees in Seongdong-gu area. (4) Small flower/bush icons (tiny colored dots) scattered in park areas for spring feel. (5) Road patterns: Add a few more subtle road lines in cream/light color to fill empty district interiors. Trees should be rendered above districts but below landmarks and hotspot markers. Create a reusable Tree SVG component that takes (x, y, size, shade) props.
sub_tasks.acceptance: 60+ trees scattered across the map. Park areas have denser tree clusters and darker green fills. Map feels lush and alive rather than empty.

sub_tasks.title: Fix zoom - smoother zoom and proper limits
sub_tasks.description: Fix the zoom system: (1) Lower minScale multiplier from 0.92 to 0.65 so users can zoom out to see full map + mountains + Gyeonggi. (2) Increase wheel zoom factor from 1.1/0.9 to 1.15/0.85 for more responsive zoom. (3) Use requestAnimationFrame-based smooth zoom interpolation instead of CSS transitions (which can lag). Store target transform and lerp toward it each frame. (4) Ensure zoom-toward-cursor works correctly with the new map dimensions. (5) Double-click zoom should animate smoothly over 300ms. (6) Reset view button should be clearly visible (bottom-right, round white button with a home icon emoji).
sub_tasks.acceptance: Zoom out shows full map including mountains and Gyeonggi. Zoom in/out is smooth and responsive. Double-click zooms smoothly. Reset button clearly visible and works.

sub_tasks.title: Weather and day/night animation overhaul
sub_tasks.description: Completely rewrite WeatherOverlay for impressive visual effects. (1) DAY/NIGHT: Based on current hour - day(07-17) bright, sunset(17-19) warm orange tint, night(19-05) dark overlay with stars and moon, dawn(05-07) soft pink. Apply as a semi-transparent overlay that tints the entire scene. At night: add 30-40 twinkling star dots (white, CSS animation varying opacity), crescent moon SVG in top-right. (2) CLEAR weather: Animated sun with rotating ray lines (CSS rotate animation), soft warm glow. Fluffy clouds (2-3) drifting slowly using CSS translateX animation. (3) RAIN: 150+ rain streak particles on canvas, darker sky overlay, cloud layer at top. Rain streaks should be clearly visible (opacity 0.6+). (4) SNOW: 80+ snowflakes with wobble drift, varying sizes 2-8px, gentle falling speed. (5) DUST: Heavy amber haze overlay (opacity 0.3), floating dust motes. (6) Weather overlay opacity should be 0.5-0.8 for particles layer (clearly visible). Sky tint overlay should be 0.2-0.4 (tints but doesn't hide map). (7) Smooth 1s crossfade between weather states.
sub_tasks.acceptance: Weather effects are clearly visible and impressive. Night shows stars and moon with dark tint. Rain has dense visible streaks. Snow is gentle and beautiful. Sun has animated rays. Day/night cycle reflects actual time.
